# Data Dictionary

Generated from `governance/metrics.yml` v2.1 on 2026-09-26.
**Do not edit this file by hand** — edit the YAML and re-run `python governance/build_dictionary.py`.

- Owner: Marketing Operations
- Review cadence: quarterly
- Last reviewed: 2026-06-30

Every metric below is validated against the live warehouse at build time. If a model or column is renamed without updating this file, CI fails.

---

## `session`

| | |
|---|---|
| **Layer** | intermediate |
| **Model** | `int_sessions` |
| **Column** | — |
| **Grain** | one row per anonymous_id per session |
| **Owner** | Marketing Ops |
| **Warehouse check** | verified |

**Definition** — A period of activity by one anonymous_id with no gap longer than 30 minutes between consecutive events. Rebuilt from raw pageviews rather than trusting the client-side session_id, which is device-local and resets across subdomains.

**Excludes**

- bot sessions (crawler user agent OR >= 25 pageviews)

**Known limitations**

- A user on two devices produces two sessions until identity resolution merges them.
- Server-side events with no anonymous_id are dropped entirely.

**Change log**

| Date | Change | By |
|---|---|---|
| 2025-04-02 | Timeout cut from 45 to 30 minutes to match GA4 default | Marketing Ops |

## `touchpoint`

| | |
|---|---|
| **Layer** | intermediate |
| **Model** | `int_touchpoints` |
| **Column** | — |
| **Grain** | one row per session |
| **Owner** | Marketing Ops |
| **Warehouse check** | verified |

**Definition** — A non-bot session that resolves to a known account and carries a mappable marketing channel. Touchpoints are the ONLY unit attribution models operate on.

**Excludes**

- sessions with no resolvable account_id
- sessions whose (utm_source, utm_medium) pair is not in channel_mapping.csv

**Known limitations**

- Offline touches (a booth conversation, a sales call) never appear.
- Dark social and word of mouth collapse into `direct`.

---

## `channel`

| | |
|---|---|
| **Layer** | intermediate |
| **Model** | `int_channel_map` |
| **Column** | — |
| **Grain** | — |
| **Owner** | Marketing Ops |
| **Warehouse check** | verified |

**Definition** — A marketing channel assigned from the (utm_source, utm_medium) pair via seeds/channel_mapping.csv. There is exactly one mapping table; nothing downstream may re-derive channel with a CASE statement.

**Governance rule** — New UTM pairs land in 'unmapped'. The assert_no_unmapped_utm_source test fails the build once an unmapped pair exceeds 5 touchpoints, forcing a mapping decision within one day rather than one quarter.

## `mql`

| | |
|---|---|
| **Layer** | staging |
| **Model** | `stg_sfdc__leads` |
| **Column** | `is_mql` |
| **Grain** | one row per lead |
| **Owner** | Demand Gen |
| **Warehouse check** | verified |

**Definition** — A lead whose CRM status has reached MQL or beyond. Status is used rather than a score threshold because the score model was re-baselined in FY25 Q3 and historical scores are not comparable.

**Known limitations**

- Duplicate lead rows inflate raw MQL counts by ~5%; use count(distinct email_normalised) for a person-level count.

## `first_touch_channel`

| | |
|---|---|
| **Layer** | marts |
| **Model** | `dim_account` |
| **Column** | `first_touch_channel` |
| **Grain** | — |
| **Owner** | Marketing Ops |
| **Warehouse check** | verified |

**Definition** — The channel of the chronologically earliest attributable touchpoint for the account, over all time (no lookback cap).

**Known limitations**

- Accounts whose first touch fell inside the Sept 2025 paid_social tracking outage are misattributed to their second touch. Affected accounts are visible in mart_data_quality.

## `attribution_lookback_window`

| | |
|---|---|
| **Layer** | intermediate |
| **Model** | `int_opportunity_touch_paths` |
| **Column** | — |
| **Grain** | — |
| **Owner** | Marketing Ops |
| **Warehouse check** | verified |

**Definition** — 365 days before opportunity creation. Set by var(touch_lookback_days).

**Why it is defined this way** — The simulated sales cycle averages 88 days but the first touch commonly precedes it by 6-9 months. analysis/05_scorecard.py shows MAE against ground truth falls from 0.058 at 30 days to 0.033 at 365 days, which is the evidence for this choice rather than convention.

---

## `credit_time_decay`

| | |
|---|---|
| **Layer** | attribution |
| **Model** | `attr_heuristic_models` |
| **Column** | `credit_time_decay` |
| **Grain** | — |
| **Owner** | Marketing Ops |
| **Warehouse check** | verified |

**Definition** — 2^(-days_before_opp / 14), normalised to sum to 1 per opportunity.

**Why it is defined this way** — 14-day half-life is the GA4/Adobe default. It is a CONVENTION, not a measurement. exports/halflife_sensitivity.csv shows the credited share of `direct` moves ~7 percentage points across half-lives from 3 to 60 days. Always publish the half-life alongside the number.

## `pipeline_roas`

| | |
|---|---|
| **Layer** | marts |
| **Model** | `mart_funnel_daily` |
| **Column** | `pipeline_roas` |
| **Grain** | — |
| **Owner** | Demand Gen |
| **Warehouse check** | verified |

**Definition** — opportunity pipeline created / media cost, at the channel-day grain.

**Known limitations**

- Organic and direct carry near-zero cost, so their ROAS is meaningless and must be suppressed on any chart that ranks channels by ROAS.
- Cost is joined on spend_date, never booked_date (booked lags 3 days).

## Segment governance

**Governance Rule** — Every audience is defined once in models/marts/fct_segment_membership.sql and registered in seeds/segment_definitions.csv with an owner, a version and an effective_from date. Rebuilding a segment inside Marketo or LinkedIn is prohibited: it creates a definition the warehouse cannot see and cannot audit.

**Versioning Rule** — Changing a segment's logic requires a version bump (v1 -> v2) and a new effective_from. Old versions are never edited in place, so a campaign that ran against v1 can still be explained six months later.

**Overlap Rule** — Any segment pair with a Jaccard index above 0.30 must have a documented suppression rule, or be merged. mart_segment_overlap surfaces these.

## Data quality thresholds

Breaching `warn` shows a caution band on the dashboard. Breaching `fail` blocks the build.

| Metric | Warn | Fail |
|---|---|---|
| `unmapped_touchpoints_pct` | 2% | 5% |
| `bot_sessions_pct` | 5% | 10% |
| `unresolved_sessions_pct` | 60% | 80% |
| `duplicate_lead_emails_pct` | 5% | 10% |
| `leads_missing_email_pct` | 4% | 8% |
